name: Reef Rune Playgrounds
introDiscord: Ancient Fae runes hop between ruined stones like pieces of a game board. Reef Rune Otters race after them, slap glowing symbols into new positions, and appear to be having the time of their lives.
introTwitch: Ancient Fae runes hop between ruined stones like pieces of a game board. Reef Rune Otters race after them, slap glowing symbols into new positions, and appear to be having the time of their lives.

glyphskip-landing.prompt: Runes bounce from stone to stone while three paths repeatedly change symbols. An otter nearby moves one rune, looks directly at you, and waits.

left.message: A Fae vessel sits behind a simple rune puzzle. The moment you solve it, an otter changes one symbol. You solve it again. The otter changes it again. Eventually it gets bored and you claim Star Candies.

right.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Runeberry tonic. I translated the warning AFTER drinking it. Apparently that was not recommended."
right.fullHpMessage: The Runeberry tonic remains unopened. You are already at full health, so the untranslated warning can stay theoretical.

forward.message: A Reef Rune Otter slaps a glowing symbol onto the floor between you. The rune flashes START. The otter immediately attacks. Apparently you entered a game.

riddlepool-ring.prompt: A circular pool displays changing riddles across its surface while otters paddle through the answers and deliberately erase important parts.

left.message: An otter presents three glowing symbols. You choose one. It dramatically reveals that every answer was apparently wrong, celebrates its victory, and charges.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache sits beneath a rune marked 'DEFINITELY NOT TREASURE.' This is the least convincing rune you have encountered. It contains Star Candies.

forward.message: Shizuki's camp note reads: "The otters call medicine cheating. I call it preparation. They also call hiding the bottle cheating. Skill issue."
forward.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's hidden medicine remains unused. At full health, you can continue arguing that preparation is not cheating.

carved-current.prompt: Animated symbols race through carved currents like pieces on a magical game board. Three passages wait while several otters gather to watch your next move.

left.message: A rune circle holds one Berry beside Shizuki's final scorecard: "Won by changing the rules halfway through. The otters objected. I cited precedent: them."

right.message: A Reef Rune Otter blocks the path and rapidly arranges glowing symbols into what appears to be an elaborate challenge. Then it simply throws one at you.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer is locked behind a rune combination. An otter helpfully demonstrates the sequence, then immediately tries to cover its own eyes. You collect Star Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Trickster Tableau
boss-antechamber.prompt: The final chamber resembles an enormous game board covered in shifting Fae symbols. Every Reef Rune Otter takes a seat along the edge like an audience.

bossPromptDiscord:
The central rune flips from PLAY to CHEAT.

The watching otters erupt into delighted splashing.

A larger figure steps onto the board and rearranges every rule at once.

Use /yes to play or /no to refuse what is clearly a completely fair and unbiased competition.
bossPromptTwitch:
The central rune flips from PLAY to CHEAT.

The watching otters erupt into delighted splashing.

A larger figure steps onto the board and rearranges every rule at once.

Use !yes to play or !no to refuse what is clearly a completely fair and unbiased competition.
bossRetreatText: You decline the Trickster's game. The otters splash in theatrical disappointment while the central rune flips back to PLAY.

boss.revealText: The runes explode into motion as the Reef-Rune Trickster bounds onto the tableau!

completionText: The Trickster finally drops its last rune. The audience of otters goes silent... then erupts into frantic applause. A new path lights up. One otter quietly changes the scoreboard after you turn away.
